Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
